reviews.text: I want to share my recent experience building a pool with Shellback Design - Luxury Pools and Landscapes.  We contracted with Shellback in March, dug in May and have been blown away at the level of professionalism, attention to detail and speed at which they completed our pool.  Our pool was not small and they also designed and built an outdoor kitchen, turf, full landscaping and a paver walkway from driveway to backyard along with a trash pad and had it all complete in under 75 days.  From design to build their team never missed a beat and incorporated the little details I never would have thought to include like glow in the dark toe tile, an elbow shelf on all seating areas, oversized hot tub, etc. The project manager, Baltasar was a dream to work with, was here daily, coordinating everyone and a crew of 8-10 was onsite daily until project completion.  I have very high standards and could not have been more impressed with their team. If you are considering building a pool, I highly recommend them and also appreciate that they are veteran owned.  Thank you to Trey, Casey, Baltasar and the entire Shellback team for their hard work.  We could not be happier with the final product.
reviews.author: Kim Rice

reviews.text:
Throwing another hat in the ring for Shellback Design! I had a very specific vision for our pool and patio area, and Trey Keierleber, Casey, and Baltasar more than delivered. My husband and I were very impressed with Trey’s attention to detail and commitment to excellence; every step felt like a bespoke experience. We absolutely love our pool!

There are so many fine details throughout the design and execution that we would never have thought of but that make a world of difference (like an oversized hot tub, toe tile on stairs, and an elbow ledge wherever people will be sitting). When it comes to big projects, there will always be at least a couple wrinkles to work through, and Trey was always willing to sit down with us and work through/explain things to our satisfaction; we never felt like just another number to him. Highly recommend Shellback for your pool or patio project … and of course, feel free to reach out if you have any questions!
reviews.author: Brittany Cragg

reviews.text: 12 weeks from dig to swim! Incredible! Our job was a tough one but Trey and his team are amazing and very capable to complete the most difficult task in a timely manner ending with a beautiful product that I love sharing with my friends and family!
reviews.author: Erica Mince

reviews.text:
I had Shellback do a pool renovation for me. Baltasar managed the project for me and did an outstanding job. One reason I brought them in was another Company did some work for me, left a leaking pool, couldn’t fix it, and took over a year to get everything done. It was a big project, but it should have been done in a few months.

Baltasar assessed the situation, figured out how to fix it and did some more plumbing work I wanted done. Specifically replacing my pump and filters as well as fixing a leaking water feature. He told me it was a week of work. I wasn’t holding my breath given the experience I just had with another contractor.

Not only was he right about his timing, they did a killer job. I couldn’t be happier. Seriously, if you are shopping a remodel or new pool/outdoor area, you are wasting your time. Just go with Shellback and you will be so happy you did. I met Trey playing golf, and I just love his whole philosophy. Keep your workers happy, and don’t over extend your crew by taking on too many projects. You will truly be the focus of his crew once you’re in process. The communication they give you too really helps keep you abreast of what is going on. I really cannot recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Jeff Burns

reviews.text: Shellback designed an awesome pool for us.  They ensure no detail is overlooked… everything is high end.  We will enjoy our new pool for years to come!  They were great to work with!
reviews.author: Ryan Klaus

reviews.text: Our pool was not built by Shellback, but we had a leak that needed repaired quickly before a big freeze.  Trey was able to get a crew out very quick to assess and repair the leak.  The crew was extremely professional and did a great job cleaning up.  Even though we were not a previous customer, Trey treated us as if we were and got us taken care of before any future damage was done.  We will definitely use Shellback for any future needs!
reviews.author: Jaren Cunningham

reviews.text: We had a great experience with shellback to build our first pool. Casey was fantastic with the design. Baltasar ensured that we had good communication during the build and kept us up to date with progress. Trey is very insightful and has helped us tremendously in this journey. Always felt comfortable working with Shellback. The project was completed on time with in 3 months start to finish. Kudos to Trey and his team of professionals!
reviews.author: Pavan Saibiwar

reviews.text:
We are at the final stages of pool construction with Trey and his Shellback team and we highly recommend them!! This is our 2nd pool build (1st with a different company) and it’s been a dramatically better experience with Shellback. Casey, the designer, walks you through the design phase, taking your vision/wishes to a whole new level. He provides guidance, preventing you from making unforeseen mistakes. Several design features that Casey recommended are some of our favorite details!

Baltasar, the superintendent, is attentive, responsive and accommodating. He is very experienced and knowledgeable. Baltasar leads each team with authority and respect. The guys respond really well to him, which makes a big difference.

Trey has formed a true A-Team that all work together seamlessly and truly care about their final product and the customers’ satisfaction. Trey asked us at least a dozen times throughout the process if we were pleased with that particular stage. Trey would often drop by to check on the work and would catch minute details that he wanted perfected. All builders say they will stop by frequently, but Trey really does.

My recommendation to anyone shopping pool/backyard oasis builders is to meet Trey, explain your budget and strongly consider moving forward with his team. Other builders will promise more for less, but from experience, I suggest you work with Shellback, due to the high levels of integrity, quality and professionalism.
reviews.author: Aubrey Marshall

data.summary: The reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The detailed, passionate content from multiple customers on Google aligns with a high-end pool builder's clientele. The significant review volume on Angi (806 reviews) with a 4.3 rating is a strong positive signal of a real, established business. The lower count on other platforms is not suspicious for a specialized contractor.
fake_signals: Low review count on Google (11) and Houzz (2) relative to Angi (806) suggests potential review solicitation focus on one platform.
authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details (timelines, crew names, design features like glow-in-the-dark toe tile, elbow shelves).
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes.
High volume of reviews on Angi (806) is normal for an established contractor.
Reviews mention both the process and the final product with genuine enthusiasm.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across all platforms. The 4.3 on Angi is still a strong rating with a very high volume of reviews (806), indicating a well-established business with a mix of feedback.
